1.consolidated_definition: Fiesta. Actividad festiva realizada en un lugar con piscina. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Otras actividades llamativas de la Convención incluyen un bingo y un karaoke, a cargo del comité municipal de San Juan, así como un pool party que organiza la Juventud Progresista (El Nuevo Día, 18-09-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pool party. Festive activity held at a location with a pool. Raw anglicism, frequent. Other attention-grabbing activities at the Convention include bingo and karaoke, organized by the San Juan municipal committee, as well as a pool party hosted by the Progressive Youth.
